note: Small, representative call-center-style sentences for the latency/quality eval framework (see eval/README.md). Not statistically powered - directional, rerunnable after any engine change.

sentences.text: Thanks for calling, how can I help you today?
Good afternoon, you've reached customer support.
Your order should arrive within three to five business days.
Your extension is six six three five.
I can see your account and the recent order you mentioned, and it shipped on Tuesday.
I understand your frustration, let me see what I can do to make this right.
I'm very sorry for the inconvenience, we'll fix this as quickly as possible.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Could you please confirm the billing address on the account?
Unfortunately the item you ordered is currently out of stock, but we expect a new shipment by next Friday.
I've added a note to your account so the carrier calls before delivery, and if anything changes I will text you right away.
Gracias por llamar, ¿en qué puedo ayudarle hoy?
Su pedido debería llegar en un plazo de tres a cinco días hábiles.
Entiendo su frustración, permítame ver qué puedo hacer para solucionarlo.
¿Hay algo más en lo que pueda ayudarle hoy?
Vielen Dank für Ihren Anruf, wie kann ich Ihnen helfen?
Ihre Bestellung sollte innerhalb von drei bis fünf Werktagen eintreffen.
Ich verstehe Ihren Ärger, lassen Sie mich sehen, was ich tun kann.
Merci de votre appel, comment puis-je vous aider aujourd'hui ?
Votre commande devrait arriver dans un délai de trois à cinq jours ouvrables.
Je comprends votre frustration, laissez-moi voir ce que je peux faire.
